api: REST API with official Python and TypeScript SDKs. Widely supported by every major orchestration framework.
cons: Consumer and enterprise data terms differ, which is a real governance trap
Model behaviour and limits change without much notice
Not the strongest at long-document reasoning or coding fidelity
name: ChatGPT
pros: Broadest capability coverage in one product
Strong at the general business writing and analysis most staff actually need
files: Accepts documents, spreadsheets, images, and code files in the paid tiers. Long context, though the exact window varies by model tier and changes frequently.
value: The broadest general-purpose assistant available, and the default most organizations encounter first. Its advantage is coverage rather than any single capability: text, code, images, voice, file analysis, and web browsing in one place, with the largest ecosystem of third-party familiarity around it.
engine: OpenAI's proprietary GPT model family. Not open weight.
latency: Fast on the standard models. Reasoning-oriented models trade noticeably longer response times for better multi-step work.

pricing.limits: Message caps, limited access to newer models

pricing.includes: Priority access, advanced models, higher limits
Admin controls, SSO, workspace data controls

quality: Strong general fluency and broad world knowledge. Like all LLMs it will state incorrect facts confidently, and it is weakest on recent events, niche technical detail, and anything requiring precise citation.
tagline: The general-purpose assistant that made conversational AI a business tool.
use_cases: Drafting and revising business writing, from board memos to customer email
Ad-hoc analysis of uploaded spreadsheets and documents without building a pipeline
Prototyping and debugging code, including for people who are not primarily developers
integrations: Direct connectors to common storage and productivity suites
governance_note: The consumer-versus-business distinction here is the single most common AI governance gap found in practice: staff use the free tier with company data under different terms than the enterprise agreement legal reviewed.
training_optout: Configurable. Business and enterprise tiers are not used to train models by default; consumer tiers require changing a setting. Verify the current terms for your specific tier before putting regulated data through it.
